source: BPHS 5th Lord of Intelligence & Higher Learning, paraphrased
effect: 5th lord shubh sthano me hone se teevra smaran shakti, competitive exams me safalta aur higher degrees ka yog banta hai.

source: Mercury in 5th or 1st Sharp analytical mind, paraphrased
effect: Budha 1st ya 5th me sharp analytical intellect, coding, mathematics aur linguistics me excellence deta hai.

source: Jupiter in 5th Wisdom and Research, paraphrased
effect: Guru ka 5th ya 9th me hona profound wisdom, scholarly inclination aur guidance/teaching field me shreshtha pradan karta hai.

source: 4th Lord in Dusthana Initial focus challenges, paraphrased
effect: 4th lord 6th ya 8th me hone par shuruwati formal padhai me thoda distraction ho sakta hai, par self-study se overcome ho jata hai.

source: Rahu in 5th Technical and out-of-box intellect, paraphrased
effect: Rahu 5th me unconventional subjects, AI, futuristic technologies aur foreign education me ruchi badhata hai.

source: Mars in 5th Engineering and Logic, paraphrased
effect: Mangal 5th me logic, technical aptitude aur competitive focus deta hai.

source: Sun in 5th High administrative capability, paraphrased
effect: Surya 5th me leadership mindset, civil services ya public administration studies ke liye anukool hai.

source: Aspect of Jupiter on 5th House, paraphrased
effect: Guru ki 5th house par drishti vidya me aane wali badhaon ko door karke focus aur retention power badhati hai.
